messages:
sarah: Anyone have must-eat recs for Osaka trip next week? Staying near Namba/Dotonbori. Izakaya vs kushikatsu, ramen, takoyaki recs appreciated 🙏
satoshi: Go kushikatsu at Daruma (Shinsekai) — cheap, iconic. Get the kushi cheese, egg, squid. Cash only usually. :yum:
priya: Takoyaki at Creo-ru in Dotonbori at night, tiny stand but amazing. Also Higashiyama ramen near Namba Station — spicy miso is great.
olivia: If you want izakaya vibes, try Tsubakiya near Hozenji Yokocho — small, reservations recommended for groups. Also hit **Kani Douraku** for crab pics :crab:
satoshi: Also Okan okonomiyaki near Dotonbori — try the modanyaki. Pro tip: ask for 'half & half' if you're indecisive.
tom: Late-night kushikatsu crawl is my fave. Start at Shinsekai, then swing back to Dotonbori for dessert. Watch for 'no double-dip' rule 🍢
kenji: @sarah if you're coming Monday night, I can make a quick list and share on the trip doc.
sarah: Yes please @kenji that'd be awesome. Also any coffee shops that's laptop-friendly in Namba for a few hours?
priya: Lilo CoffeeRoasters by Namba Parks is chill. Good WiFi, friendly staff. Also 'Brooklyn Roasting' in Amerikamura is busy but nice.
canteen-bot: FYI: Osaka office lunch subsidy doesn't apply to personal travel meals ;)
olivia: If you want a fancier meal, book 'Hajime' (3 Michelin — if budget allows) — but it's a bit out of central Namba.
sarah: Thanks all! @satoshi @tom leaning kushikatsu first night, izakaya second. Will post picks in travel channel later. Any halal options near Dotonbori?
kenji: There's 'Naruto' halal ramen in Nipponbashi ~10min walk. DM me if you want directions.
priya: :thumbsup: saving these — will add to pinned messages.
tom: Pics pls when you go! :camera_with_flash:
